description: Full logits (V=36) at every position, float64, from the DEQUANTIZED int8 weights in doodle_weights.ps (int8 * printed scale; RMSNorm weights as printed).
convention: logits[t] is the model output after feeding tokens[t] at position t, with tokens[0..t-1] already in the KV cache (llama2.c forward(token, pos)); it predicts tokens[t+1]. logits[65] (after the last patch) is included for completeness.
forward: numpy float64, one token at a time, same operation order as llama2.c run.c / engine2.ps
tolerance_hint: PostScript reals are 32-bit floats: expect |diff| ~1e-4..1e-3 on logits, identical argmax except where min_patch_top2_gap is tiny.

trace.note: residual stream x after each layer, positions 0 and 1 of sequence 0
